en: The postcard shows a historic, colorized illustration of a European cityscape with grand multi-story buildings, a tree-lined avenue, and a palm tree in the foreground. Decorative flowers and a banner with the words 'Pozdrav iz Sušaka' appear on the left, while the name 'Josipa Radići – Sušak' is written vertically on the right. The buildings are of classic Central European architectural style, and the scene suggests a coastal or riverside location.
